$comment: Whose opinion a conjecture cites, and its weight. authoritative: Catholic biblical scholarship and reference works, and peer-reviewed scholarship, cited by location (a note, an introduction, a dictionary sense, a page). non-authoritative: anything else (a claim with no reference behind it, a non-Catholic work outside peer review, an encyclopedia anyone edits), kept as a lead until an authoritative source is found.
